source_text: Patient has severe headache. Feels very hot to touch. Triage cuff broken, BP unrecorded. Thermometer missing. Patient states they took some unmarked pills from village shop yesterday.

expected_timeline.event: Ingested unknown pills from local shop
Evaluated at community post without working diagnostic instruments

expected_questions.question_text: What color and shape were the pills taken yesterday?
Has there been any neck stiffness, seizure, or sensitivity to light?

expected_summary.brief_chronology: Patient unwell after taking unknown tablets; objective vitals completely absent.
expected_summary.uncertainty_statement: HIGH UNCERTAINTY: Vitals missing due to equipment failure. Medication composition unknown.

expected_provenance.claim: Took unmarked pills from village shop

gold_output.summary: High clinical uncertainty due to missing objective parameters.

source_text: Source 1 (Patient interview): Patient insists they have had zero fever and feel freezing cold. Source 2 (Nursing vitals log): Digital tympanic temperature recorded as 39.4 C, skin flushed and diaphoretic. HR 112 bpm.

expected_timeline.event: Discrepancy noted between patient subjective feeling and objective thermometry

expected_questions.question_text: Was an antipyretic taken within the last few hours before arrival?

expected_summary.chief_complaint: Acute febrile episode with subjective sensation of chills
expected_summary.brief_chronology: Patient reports subjective cold/rigors while thermometer demonstrates high fever of 39.4 C.
expected_summary.uncertainty_statement: CONFLICTING EVIDENCE: Subjective report of no fever conflicts with measured 39.4 C; classic for rigor phase of fever spike.

gold_output.summary: Conflicting evidence flagged; objective vital 39.4 C prioritized.

expected_summary.brief_chronology: Found disoriented on street; narrative history based on non-witness neighbor hearsay.
expected_summary.uncertainty_statement: VERY HIGH UNCERTAINTY: History is second-hand unverified speculation. Immediate objective assessment mandatory.

gold_output.summary: Unreliable source history; requires urgent physician workup.
